title: Astro Portal API v1 — the storage of a space, for a device
description: `GET /v1/space/storage` (a device token or the web session): the bytes the space uses (every stored image of every capture, the uploads in progress included), its quota and what remains, the per-file ceiling, its captures and their limit (`capture.count_limit`), the images a capture may hold beyond its main one (`capture.variant_limit`), and the composed capabilities of the person — exactly those `GET /v1/capabilities` answers, fourteen keys. Astro Sync's « Récapitulatif » checks a sending against it before any byte leaves; the service checks again at reception. A number the profile does not cap is the unlimited sentinel (`Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`, capabilities.ts), never a missing field; a private server answers what its profile carries.

remainingBytes.description: `quotaBytes - usedBytes` (never below 0); the unlimited sentinel when the quota is.
